title: Your turn: Audit your posts for unrepeatable facts
text: Post that writes for you. LinkedIn also downranks AI content. The same company builds the faucet and reports the flood. Where could this be wrong? Detection is a probability, not a confession. But Substack and Reddit sit at the bottom of the same scan. So this is not AI. This is LinkedIn. Two things follow. If you are building a personal brand there, the medium is now suspected by default. My read, not a finding. And since August 2nd, article 50 requires disclosure. The verdict. One, LinkedIn is the most AI saturated platform measured. Two, it is all or nothing. The assisted middle is 4.3%. Three, the platform sells the tool and penalizes the output. If you actually write, that is now an advantage. Your turn. Paste this. Take my last 10 LinkedIn posts and for each tell me which parts only I could have written, a number, a name, something that went wrong, and which parts any model would produce. Then rewrite the weakest using only what is unrepable. Look for whether it points at facts, not adjectives. Nobody wrote this. Make sure somebody wrote yours. I'm Yatra. Thanks for watching.
